blocks.heading: How does dining work on Princess?
blocks.text: We're glad you asked... here's a breakdown of the dining categories we offer onboard.

blocks.heading: Restaurants with flavors for everyone
blocks.text: From formal dining to casual eats, enjoy a variety of fresh flavors and personalized service. See some of our top-rated restaurants:

blocks.heading: A taste of Italian tradition
blocks.text: Step inside Sabatini’s℠ Italian Trattoria and savor the craftsmanship behind every dish. Using artisanal techniques and fresh, select ingredients, our chefs celebrate the traditions that define true Italian cuisine. Enjoy the journey of flavor—one dish at a time.

blocks.heading: Discover the craft behind The Catch by Rudi
blocks.text: Master Chef and Head of Culinary Arts Rudi Sodamin has created a menu for this specialty dining experience, drawing inspiration from both the land and sea. Enjoy fresh seafood, chilled oysters, grilled fish, pasta, and succulent steaks, all served with exceptional flair.

blocks.heading: A signature steakhouse at sea
blocks.text: Discover premium steakhouse dining at Crown Grill, where carefully aged cuts are prepared to perfection, complemented by a curated selection of gourmet salts and served in a refined, classic steakhouse setting.

blocks.heading: Savor culinary excellence at Chef's Table
blocks.text: An extravagant menu with wine pairings from our executive chef, the Chef’s Table† is a treat for certified foodies and gourmet novices alike.

blocks.heading: Get immersed in 360: An Extraordinary Experience
blocks.text: This seven-course event, designed to elevate all your senses, perfectly balances fine dining and visual entertainment.‡

blocks.heading: Experience the wonder of Spellbound by Magic Castle
blocks.text: Nestled behind a non-descript door, you’ll enjoy feats of magic from magicians, surprises in themed rooms and theatrical cocktails delivered by sleight-of-hand servers.§

blocks.heading: Taste Caymus wines in a night of fine dining
blocks.text: This dinner features a fine dining food menu paired with wines personally selected by Chuck Wagner, owner and winemaker of Caymus Vineyards in Napa Valley.

blocks.heading: Indulge in a balcony breakfast or dinner
blocks.text: Served by our dedicated waitstaff in the comfort of your own balcony, choose a luxurious breakfast or romantic four-course dinner at sea.

blocks.heading: Meet the culinary artists behind the craft
Darren McGrady, The Royal Chef
blocks.text: Personal chef to Queen Elizabeth II, Princess Diana and Prince Harry, plus serving five U.S. presidents, Chef Darren McGrady shares his expertise through Royal Afternoon Tea - a unique storytelling experience with traditional fixings of tea pairings with scones and pastries.

blocks.heading: Rudi Sodamin, Head of Princess Culinary Arts
blocks.text: Chef Rudi Sodamin is an internationally respected food authority and a legend in the culinary world. In addition to being our fleetwide executive chef, he pioneered “The Catch by Rudi,” an exquisite onboard seafood restaurant that brings the simplicity of fresh, sustainable seafood to your table.

blocks.heading: Makoto Okuwa, master of Edomae-style sushi
blocks.text: One of Miami’s most accomplished chefs, Chef Okuwa excels in crafting sushi fresh from Tokyo Bay. He combines his 20+ years of experience in traditional Japanese-style cooking with innovative techniques for an authentic Japanese dining experience at Princess’ very own Makoto Ocean.

blocks.heading: Tony Gemingnani, 13-time World Pizza Champion
blocks.text: Pizza Chef Tony Gemignani created unique pizzas just for Princess, including Alfredo’s Pizzeria and Gigi’s Pizzeria by Alfredo as well as the top deck pizza – further enhancing Princess’ position as offering the best pizza at sea.

blocks.heading: Dario Cecchini, world-renowned butcher
blocks.text: As "the world's most famous butcher," Dario Cecchini brings expertise from a long line of Italian butchers. He believes it's important to bring back the sacredness of food, and brings this carnivore's paradise onboard.

blocks.heading: World class mixology and renowned artist collaborations
blocks.text: Through exclusive partnerships with visionary founders, we bring distinctive spirits and unique stories onboard.

blocks.heading: Poured to perfection. Curated for you.
blocks.text: Introducing POURS, our signature beverage collection featuring renowned founder-led spirits and botanical-rich, zero-proof and nonalcoholic creations enhanced with natural adaptogens. Experience the perfect way to toast to your travels or find a moment of calm. Only on Princess, every glass is poured to enrich your journey and foster unforgettable connections. blocks.text: Make the most of your dining experience onboard—from casual bites to specialty restaurants—and enjoy included drinks throughout your cruise. With Princess Premier® or Princess Plus® you can enjoy more of what you love onboard, while saving up to 70% per day, per guest when you book before you sail.*

blocks.heading: How does dining work on Princess?
blocks.text: We're glad you asked... here's a breakdown of the dining categories we offer onboard.

blocks.heading: Restaurants with flavors for everyone
blocks.text: From formal dining to casual eats, enjoy a variety of fresh flavors and personalized service. See some of our top-rated restaurants:

blocks.heading: A taste of Italian tradition
blocks.text: Step inside Sabatini’s℠ Italian Trattoria and savor the craftsmanship behind every dish. Using artisanal techniques and fresh, select ingredients, our chefs celebrate the traditions that define true Italian cuisine. Enjoy the journey of flavor—one dish at a time.

blocks.heading: Discover the craft behind The Catch by Rudi
blocks.text: Master Chef and Head of Culinary Arts Rudi Sodamin has created a menu for this specialty dining experience, drawing inspiration from both the land and sea. Enjoy fresh seafood, chilled oysters, grilled fish, pasta, and succulent steaks, all served with exceptional flair.

blocks.heading: A signature steakhouse at sea
blocks.text: Discover premium steakhouse dining at Crown Grill, where carefully aged cuts are prepared to perfection, complemented by a curated selection of gourmet salts and served in a refined, classic steakhouse setting.

blocks.heading: Savor culinary excellence at Chef's Table
blocks.text: An extravagant menu with wine pairings from our executive chef, the Chef’s Table† is a treat for certified foodies and gourmet novices alike.

blocks.heading: Get immersed in 360: An Extraordinary Experience
blocks.text: This seven-course event, designed to elevate all your senses, perfectly balances fine dining and visual entertainment.‡

blocks.heading: Experience the wonder of Spellbound by Magic Castle
blocks.text: Nestled behind a non-descript door, you’ll enjoy feats of magic from magicians, surprises in themed rooms and theatrical cocktails delivered by sleight-of-hand servers.§

blocks.heading: Taste Caymus wines in a night of fine dining
blocks.text: This dinner features a fine dining food menu paired with wines personally selected by Chuck Wagner, owner and winemaker of Caymus Vineyards in Napa Valley.

blocks.heading: Indulge in a balcony breakfast or dinner
blocks.text: Served by our dedicated waitstaff in the comfort of your own balcony, choose a luxurious breakfast or romantic four-course dinner at sea.

blocks.heading: Meet the culinary artists behind the craft
Darren McGrady, The Royal Chef
blocks.text: Personal chef to Queen Elizabeth II, Princess Diana and Prince Harry, plus serving five U.S. presidents, Chef Darren McGrady shares his expertise through Royal Afternoon Tea - a unique storytelling experience with traditional fixings of tea pairings with scones and pastries.

blocks.heading: Rudi Sodamin, Head of Princess Culinary Arts
blocks.text: Chef Rudi Sodamin is an internationally respected food authority and a legend in the culinary world. In addition to being our fleetwide executive chef, he pioneered “The Catch by Rudi,” an exquisite onboard seafood restaurant that brings the simplicity of fresh, sustainable seafood to your table.

blocks.heading: Makoto Okuwa, master of Edomae-style sushi
blocks.text: One of Miami’s most accomplished chefs, Chef Okuwa excels in crafting sushi fresh from Tokyo Bay. He combines his 20+ years of experience in traditional Japanese-style cooking with innovative techniques for an authentic Japanese dining experience at Princess’ very own Makoto Ocean.

blocks.heading: Tony Gemingnani, 13-time World Pizza Champion
blocks.text: Pizza Chef Tony Gemignani created unique pizzas just for Princess, including Alfredo’s Pizzeria and Gigi’s Pizzeria by Alfredo as well as the top deck pizza – further enhancing Princess’ position as offering the best pizza at sea.

blocks.heading: Dario Cecchini, world-renowned butcher
blocks.text: As "the world's most famous butcher," Dario Cecchini brings expertise from a long line of Italian butchers. He believes it's important to bring back the sacredness of food, and brings this carnivore's paradise onboard.

blocks.heading: World class mixology and renowned artist collaborations
blocks.text: Through exclusive partnerships with visionary founders, we bring distinctive spirits and unique stories onboard.

headings.text: Poured to perfection. Curated for you.

blocks.heading: Poured to perfection. Curated for you.
blocks.text: Discover POURS, our signature beverage collection featuring founder-led premium spirits that celebrate the art of the pour to sophisticated zero-proof and nonalcoholic creations crafted for a wellness-forward journey.​ Whether you are looking to start your morning with a vibrant botanical blend or toast to the sunset with a premium spirit, every pour is an invitation to stay balanced and present.

blocks.heading: By the bar or poolside
blocks.text: From the energy of our bars to the ease of poolside moments, POURS is designed to be enjoyed wherever you choose to unwind, sip, and savor your time at sea.

blocks.heading: Spirits collection
blocks.text: We collaborate with renowned brand founders to create experiences you won’t find anywhere else.​

blocks.heading: Pantalones Organic Tequila
blocks.text: Matthew and Camila McConaughey Pantalones Organic Tequila brings a smooth expression of tequila to life at sea. Enjoy a Fancy Pants Margarita and keep an eye out for the tequila cart making the rounds onboard.

blocks.heading: Sláinte Irish Whiskey
blocks.text: Liev Schreiber​ Raise a glass to Sláinte Irish Whiskey, a celebrated expression of Irish craft and tradition. Sláinte brings refined character and rich heritage to every pour.

blocks.heading: Meili Vodka
blocks.text: Jason Momoa and Blaine Halvorson​ Crafted using natural spring water and sustainable practices, Meili is single-distilled vodka created by actor and environmental advocate, Jason Momoa and his partner and creative director, Blaine Halvorson.

blocks.heading: Hampton Water
blocks.text: Jon Bon Jovi and Jesse Bongiovi Born from the vision of Jesse and his father, Jon Bon Jovi, Hampton Water blends the energy of the Hamptons with the elegance of the South of France. Bright, refined, and refreshing, it’s the perfect rosé to enjoy while at sea.

blocks.heading: Archer Roose Wines
blocks.text: Elizabeth Banks and Marian Leitner-Waldman Luxury wine, reimagined. Archer Roose brings bold, premium flavors from the best winemakers and wine-growing regions around the world into sustainable cans. Convenient, modern, and full of flavor.

blocks.heading: Melorosa Wines
blocks.text: Jason Aldean, Chuck and Kasi Wicks​ Crafted by Jason Aldean, Kasi Wicks, and Chuck Wicks, Melorosa Wines are the perfect match for your onboard dining experience. From California vineyards to your glass, their Sauvignon Blanc and Cabernet Sauvignon are made to pair with delicious food and even better company.

blocks.heading: Love by Britto Prosecco
blocks.text: Romero Britto Celebrate every moment with Love by Britto Prosecco, a vibrant expression of joy and artistry. This crisp, effervescent prosecco brings elegance to every toast — inspired by the iconic style of Romero Britto.

blocks.heading: Seven Daughters Moscato
blocks.text: Taraji P. Henson​​ From relaxed afternoons to celebratory evenings, Seven Daughters Moscato brings a bright, lightly sweet profile that makes every moment feel a little more vibrant.

blocks.heading: Zero-proof & nonalcoholic collection
blocks.text: Alcohol-free doesn’t mean flavor-free. Whether you’re looking to stay energized or unwind, each creation is crafted to relax the mind and refresh the palate. ​

blocks.heading: No Alcohol Sparkling Rosé
blocks.text: Kylie Minogue A bright, bubbly escape in every glass, No Alcohol Sparkling Rosé brings refreshing berry notes to your journey — perfect for sipping from sunrise to sunset at sea.

blocks.heading: Zero-proof artistry. Botanical bliss.
blocks.text: POURS is crafted with purpose. Our zero-proof creations are thoughtfully designed with adaptogens, botanicals, and exceptional flavors to help you feel your best on vacation.
